s: Administrator guide for the IE2 platform underlying IRIS: creating user accounts, user groups and unrestricted access, Single Sign-On authentication ID, password resets, archiving and locked accounts, registering sites, assigning user access/permissions, permissions reports, managing lookup lists, audit logs, data archiving, and uploading help/guidance documents.

Guide to creating standard reports in IE2/IRIS: report settings and criteria, adding/removing/reordering data table columns, aggregation, column visibility and editing, calculations, building Bar/Column/Line/Pie graphs, results page layout, deleting a report, and managing the reports list.
Guide to the IE2/IRIS Search Engine: the Spotlight and All Tables search tabs, building search criteria, reading search results, download options, and creating and publishing saved searches.

Guide for the IRIS Support Team covering the main areas of admin support: adding/amending/removing user accounts and permissions, adding/amending/removing departments and buildings, reassigning incidents between departments, amending details on incident forms, and functionality changes such as amending dropdown list options.
Service Level Description for the Incident Reporting and Investigation System (IRIS): document ownership and sign-off, service scope and description, support contacts, and service governance history.

t: IRIS Baseline Data — User Groups, Data Flows & Data Model
s: Reference spreadsheet covering IRIS user groups and their permissions/access levels by data table (Incident Reporting Form, Person Involved, DSO Review, Investigations, Actions), the system's data flows (inputs/outputs), the user onboarding process step by step, and a full data model overview listing every field by system area/data table with special-category (GDPR) flags.

t: Odyssey System Guidance — Configuration, Inventory & Waste Management
s: System administration guide for Odyssey (Radiation Management System): department/EA permit configuration, unsealed and sealed source inventory management (add/edit, aliquots, change of state), waste management and bin inventory, radiation protection instruments (RPI) and machine management, reporting, inventory templates, and permissions structure.

t: Radiation Management System (Odyssey) — Service Level Agreement
s: Service Level Agreement for Odyssey, the University's Radiation Management System: purpose and parties to the agreement, service description, hours of service and support, approvals and document history.

t: Odyssey Guidance — Worker Registration, Reports & Support
s: User guidance for Odyssey worker registration and day-to-day use: registering a new radiation worker (including external institutes and visitors), keeping worker records updated, running/downloading/automating reports, system admin and set-up (login, department details, signature, accessibility), and system support troubleshooting including common queries about registration and work-type forms.

t: Registering a New Radiation Worker — Workflow Summary
s: Short workflow summary of the multi-stage Odyssey worker registration process: SRPS/RPS initiation, worker completion via SSO, RPS review, SRPS review, Academic Line Manager review, and final Safety Office compliance review.

Describes the current, fully automated data import process into Cardinus (Healthy Working Plus): user data extracted from PeopleXD, transformed by the University's Azure team, and transferred to Cardinus via SFTP every Wednesday — replacing the previous manual Excel/CSV/FileZilla process. Covers the SSO unique identifier and how leavers are archived.

Historical record of the manual, pre-automation Cardinus import process: extracting people data from Work Tribe, processing with Alteryx, preparing and filtering the CSV file, and the step-by-step tasks required before each import. Kept for reference alongside the current automated process.

f: ITS960 DSE - Workflow for distributed approach.pdf
s: Workflow diagram for the distributed Display Screen Equipment (DSE) assessment approach: the roles involved (user, DSE admin system/PACE, DSE Coordinator, DSE Assessor/Equipment provider, Occupational Health specialist input, Central admin) and the sequence from invitation through course/assessment completion, risk resolution, and reporting.

Summary of the authorisation levels/roles available in Cardinus (Healthy Working Plus) — DSE Coordinator, DSE Assessor, and Departmental Safety Officer — describing each role's responsibilities, the PACE functionality needed, and the recommended authorisation level for each.
